_about: Curated year-by-year supplement written for GeoHistory from general knowledge (conservative: well-established dates only). Each entry names the English Wikipedia article it is about; tools/build_curated.py sets "verified" when the Wikidata item of that article carries the same year. Places are approximate (nearest town).

events.label: Suez Canal opens
events.desc: The canal links the Mediterranean and the Red Sea.

events.label: Battle of Isandlwana
events.desc: A Zulu army destroys a British column.

events.label: Treaty of Bardo
events.desc: Tunisia becomes a French protectorate.

events.label: Battle of Tel el-Kebir
events.desc: British troops defeat the Egyptian army of Urabi; the British occupation of Egypt begins.

events.label: Berlin Conference opens
events.desc: The European powers agree rules for claiming African territory; the conference ends in February 1885.

events.label: Fall of Khartoum
events.desc: Mahdist forces take Khartoum and kill General Gordon.

events.label: Congo Free State established
events.desc: The Berlin Conference recognises Leopold II's personal rule over the Congo basin.

events.label: Gold found on the Witwatersrand
events.desc: The gold rush that creates Johannesburg.

events.label: Heligoland–Zanzibar Treaty
events.desc: Britain and Germany settle their East African spheres.

events.label: First Matabele War
events.desc: The British South Africa Company defeats the Ndebele kingdom.

events.label: Jameson Raid
events.desc: A failed raid from British territory into the Transvaal.

events.label: Battle of Adwa
events.desc: Ethiopia under Menelik II defeats an Italian army and keeps its independence.

events.label: Battle of Omdurman
events.desc: Kitchener's Anglo-Egyptian army defeats the Mahdist state.

events.label: Fashoda Incident
events.desc: British and French expeditions meet on the upper Nile; France backs down.

events.label: Second Boer War begins
events.desc: War between Britain and the two Boer republics; it ends in 1902.

events.label: Herero uprising and genocide
events.desc: German forces in South West Africa answer a Herero rising with a campaign of extermination.

events.label: Maji Maji Rebellion
events.desc: A wide rising against German rule in East Africa.

events.label: Belgium annexes the Congo
events.desc: After an international outcry over atrocities, the Congo Free State becomes a Belgian colony.

events.label: Union of South Africa formed
events.desc: The Cape, Natal, Transvaal and Orange River colonies unite as a British dominion.

events.label: Agadir Crisis
events.desc: Germany sends a gunboat to Morocco; France gains a free hand there in return for land in the Congo.

events.label: Treaty of Fes
events.desc: Most of Morocco becomes a French protectorate.
